# The reactions

## Reactions and the engine IDs that run them

A reaction is what the notes and the paper call R1, R2, ... . The engine runs some
reactions as several IDs, because every event of one ID must have the same rate.
Event logs report counts by reaction; the engine ID is only a reference.

- **R3**: the three IDs break the same As-H bond and share one parameter set (`A_E3`, `Ea_E3`, `beta_E3`).
- **R1, R2, R6, R7** (adsorption): terrace and step have their own sticking coefficients, `S0_A_terrace`,
  `S0_A_step`, `S0_M_terrace`, `S0_M_step`, with S0_terrace <= S0_step enforced.
- **IDs 34, 35**: E4.2 (AsH on a D_MMGa) and E6.2 (MMGa on a D_AsH) with both upper sites free. The host has one
  dangling bond, and its methyl / H moves out of the way, so the adsorbate can land on either site: two
  events at half the rate each, so the host adsorbs at the rate of one site. With one site free, the
  landing is an ordinary ID-6 / ID-9 event at the full rate.
- **R12-R17** (incorporation): the IDs of one reaction differ only in the partner, a spectator, and share one
  parameter set: R12 `A_E14`, R13 `A_E17`, R14 `A_E26`, R15 `A_E20`, R16 `A_E29`, R17 `A_E23`.
  Terrace or step is decided on either side: a step if the host's or the partner's other upper bond
  holds an incorporated atom.
- **IDs 36-77** (27 Sep): methyl removal from an adsorbed MMGa (R8, ID 36); desorption of an adsorbed Ga
  (R18) and its terrace / step incorporation (R19, R20); a partner below that is an adsorbed
  precursor of the other element (IDs 44-59, cases of R12-R17, R19, R20); desorption of every film
  atom with two / three bonds at R10 / R11's rate (IDs 60-65); a film atom's free bond bonding
  down to a free bond below (IDs 66-77, cases of its kind's incorporation). No bond forms
  automatically: an H or a methyl rotates out of the way, and every bond is one of these events.

## Every engine ID

77 engine IDs. 69 carry an Arrhenius rate k = A x T^beta x exp(-Ea/T), with **Ea in kelvin**;
the remaining 8 are adsorption events whose rate comes from the impingement flux,
not from a prefactor and a barrier. Parameter names keep the engine ID (`A_E12` is ID 12).

## Species names

| symbol | meaning |
|---|---|
| `V_As, V_Ga` | vacant As / Ga site |
| `S_As, S_Ga` | substrate As / Ga |
| `As, Ga` | fully incorporated bulk atom |
| `D_X, DD_X` | X with one / two dangling bonds |
| `DDD_As, DDD_Ga` | As / Ga with one bond and three dangling bonds (adsorbed) |
| `MMGa` | monomethylgallium, CH3-Ga |
| `AsH` | arsenic hydride |

## The six parameters that are not per-reaction

| parameter | enters |
|---|---|
| `S0_A_terrace`, `S0_A_step` | AsH sticking probability `S0 x exp(-Ea_chem_As/T)` on a terrace, engine IDs 6, 7, 34 (R1; catalog 0.04), and at a step, ID 8 (R2; catalog 0.08) |
| `S0_M_terrace`, `S0_M_step` | the same for MMGa: IDs 9, 10, 35 (R6; catalog 0.04) and ID 11 (R7; catalog 0.08) |
| `Ea_chem_As`, `Ea_chem_M` | the sticking barriers (catalog 5500 K each) |

Ordering constraints, checked on every run (`KMC._CONSTRAINTS`): `Ea_E32` < `Ea_E33`; `Ea_E17` < `Ea_E14`; `Ea_E20` < `Ea_E26`; `Ea_E23` < `Ea_E29`; `S0_A_terrace` <= `S0_A_step`; `S0_M_terrace` <= `S0_M_step`; `Ea_E37` < `Ea_E32`; `Ea_E41` < `Ea_E38`.

The partial pressures are fixed in the engine at the experiment's values
(608 and 65.86 Pa, standing for AsH and MMGa), so `S0` carries that degree of freedom: only the
product `pressure x S0` enters an impingement rate.

Total: 16 x 3 Arrhenius parameters + 6 = 54.
